candidates.counter_evidence_explanation: Gateway metrics and logs are healthy, consistent with order being the failing hop rather than the gateway; they do not contradict an order-side 500 fault.
missing_evidence: Order error stack traces or exception types to identify the failing code path
Order dependency-level spans (inventory, payment, postgresql) to localize the 500 origin
candidates.statement: Order service is the fault locus: order checkout spans error at 1350ms, order logs show 9 unhandled request failures with status 500, and order error_rate is 0.16 with p95 440ms, while gateway, inventory and payment metrics stay near baseline (error_rate 0.0012, p95 77ms).
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record (3.3.1, 727 min old) cannot establish deployment causation; no memory-retention facts supplied.

report.explanation: Current telemetry localizes errors and latency to the order service: erroring checkout spans, 9 status-500 unhandled failures, and elevated error_rate/p95, while gateway, inventory and payment remain healthy. Root cause is bounded to order-side HTTP 500, but the specific failing code path or dependency is not yet established.
